question: Can function currently encoded redundantly in static DeltaNet weights be represented more cheaply in STATE plus a transition operator?

verdict.decision_applies_to: replacing DeltaNet static in_proj/out_proj with rec_state + a cheaper transition, on this model, as a production representation
why: 0 of 7 static tensors duplicate information S already carries. S stores the image of W, not W.
The organ's work is the projections: 11120148480 MAC-FLOP vs 113246208.0 state-update FLOP (98.19×). Isolated DN GEMV is 90.51% addressing.
Capacity: rec_state 150994944 B cannot store in_proj_qkvz 2.14 GB. Rank-1 update is many-to-one (shader algebra).

TOKEN_NS already has a native recurrent op. The 10.6% component is that op plus helpers, after GEMV and state-stream have been attributed out. Building another transition does not stop the 2.95 GB stream.
Prior science that would have to reverse first: G034/Phase-B, G035, G089 OOD, MLP distill NO-GO, 223 sub-0.5 local BPW with 0 healthy.
State CONTENT is reused; state TRAFFIC is re-read every token (stream_rec_state 0.467 ms). 'Reuse is free' is false on this machine.
verdict.what_would_reopen: A native operator, scored on REAL held-out activations with a scale-aware gate (not cosine), that matches the incumbent q4 in_proj/out_proj on Doctor/function-space AND drops active bytes AND drops GEMV addressing time. Reconstruction of dense W as an oracle is not that operator.

duplication_sites.role: static map hidden → (q,k,v,z) for the CURRENT token
duplication_sites.why: Produces the rank-1 factors and the query of THIS token. rec_state (150994944 B) stores the decayed SUM of past k v^T (crates/hawking-core/shaders/qwen38_device_activations.metal:353: state += k * delta). That map is many-to-one: k_t, v_t, q_t are not recoverable from S_t. S cannot hold this matrix (2139096960 B on disk vs 150994944 B resident S).

duplication_sites.role: static map hidden → (beta, a) that parameterise THIS token's decay/beta
duplication_sites.why: ba is an activation of the current hidden. decay = exp(-exp(A_log) * softplus(a+dt_bias)) at crates/hawking-core/shaders/qwen80_device_activations.metal:207. S is multiplied by that decay; S does not store the ba map.

duplication_sites.role: FIR taps (k=4) on the qkvz channels
duplication_sites.why: conv_state is the delay line of the last (k-1) activations per channel (crates/hawking-core/shaders/qwen38_device_activations.metal:23 shifts history and writes current). conv1d.weight is the 4 taps. Delay line ≠ taps. conv_state resident 5898240 B; conv weights 7864704 B on disk.

duplication_sites.role: per-head static timescale of the transition
duplication_sites.why: 48 f32 per layer. Already a parameter of the transition operator, not content of S. Could be folded into the kernel as a constant; that saves 9.6 kB, not 2.95 GB.

duplication_sites.role: per-head static bias on the a-logit before softplus
duplication_sites.why: Same class as A_log: a transition parameter, 9.6 kB, not S.

duplication_sites.role: gated RMSNorm affine on rec_out (the S@q readout), not on S
duplication_sites.why: Kernel binds rec_out + z + norm.weight (crates/hawking-core/src/model/qwen38_hybrid_decode.rs:3166). Affine is 128 f32. Not a copy of the 786432-element S.

Mixes a READOUT of S into residual space. The matrix is not in S. Composing out_proj_L with in_proj_{L+1} produces a larger map (16384×6144) and still leaves the residual path W@h to do, so it does not save bytes.

content_persists_across_tokens.evidence: rec_state is allocated once (crates/hawking-core/src/model/qwen38_hybrid_decode.rs:715, 150994944 B), zeroed in attach (crates/hawking-core/src/model/qwen38_hybrid_decode.rs:1292) and reset (crates/hawking-core/src/model/qwen38_hybrid_decode.rs:1512), and NOT zeroed in step() (hits=[]). step() increments position (crates/hawking-core/src/model/qwen38_hybrid_decode.rs:3878) and re-encodes against the same buffer.

The kernel loads state[index] from device (crates/hawking-core/shaders/qwen38_device_activations.metal:342). state_reuse.verdict: State reuse of CONTENT is exploited (the organ is recurrent). State reuse of TRAFFIC is not free: the 151 MiB rec_state is re-read and re-written from unified memory every token. TOKEN_NS puts that traffic in kv_state (stream floor 0.467 ms rec + 0.019 ms conv), not in the 10.6% deltanet component.

native_operator.would_need: A kernel that emits q,k,v,z,b,a (or a sufficient statistic) from rec_state plus a cheap feature of h, without streaming the Q4 in_proj/out_proj. No such kernel is in the 38 dispatched, the 4 helper-dispatched, or the REACHABLE set under recurrent_state_operator.
native_operator.production_eligibility_today: A representation is executable TODAY only if it is grouped-absmax Q4, binary±CSR, HGRAVS01 factors, PQ codebook lookup, MoE worklists, or a recurrent state op. The recurrent state op exists and already runs. Replacing in_proj is a new representation and is not executable today.

G060_latent_kv.obligation: G060 -- does a latent KV win survive at the context an agent actually uses
G060_latent_kv.verdict_corrected: THE WIN SURVIVES, BUT IT IS THE SECOND LEVER. An earlier reading of these numbers would say latent KV does not help because bytes are not what the path pays for. That is wrong: the path costs 212.7 ps per ELEMENT, so removing 43% of the elements removes 43% of the context term and is a genuine 1.39x on the token at 8192. What the measurement actually establishes is ORDERING -- the kernel's 253x per-element inefficiency dominates the representation's 1.74x, and after the kernel is fixed latent KV is worth 1.003x. Fix the kernel first.

G089_latent_runtime.obligation: G089 -- can the source width be compiled down; answering the late-layer rank obstacle
G089_latent_runtime.out_of_distribution: The same basis retains only 81.0% of multilingual, 91.0% of adversarial and 94.2% of long. The in-minus-held gap narrows with rank but does not close: +0.138 at r=256, +0.100 at r=2048, +0.072 at r=3500. At the d_model width the same shape is sharper -- a prose-fitted basis holds 98.4% of held-out PROSE and 78.2% of CODE, a 20-point gap at its own full rank.

prior_science.G035_corrected_verdict: AXIS-DEPENDENT, which the original refutation did not distinguish. Sharing the COLUMN space (the contraction axis) LOSES on 3/3 pairs.
